summary: BOM Editor fix VERIFIED in iteration_4. Masters.jsx line 201 material Select onValueChange now uses functional setForm updater; addLine/updLine/rmLine at lines 137-139 all use functional updaters. Repro flow passes end-to-end: (1) Add BOM → Article X → Rexine Black → 0.3 → save-bom captured POST /api/boms with lines[0].material_id='59b8dffe-...' and consumption_per_pair=0.3, 'BOM saved' toast shown, dialog closed, new v1 row appeared. (2) Edit existing BOM → added a new Buckle line via add-bom-line, set version=2 → PUT /api/boms/{id} fired with 6 lines including newly added material_id 5d790c91-... and qty 1.5, toast success. (3) Regression nav (Dashboard, Customer Orders, Production, Stock Room, Dispatch, Fabricators, Reports, Masters) all render with 0 JS console errors.

issues: Radix a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — cosmetic, unchanged from prior iterations.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Dialog components in Masters.jsx to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Functional-updater pattern in BomMaster (lines 137-139, 201) is the correct defensive fix and eliminates the stale-closure risk seen in previous iterations. Consider applying the same pattern anywhere else the codebase chains multiple setState calls on the same key.
updLine could be refactored to accept a partial object (updLine(i, {material_id, uom})) to consolidate multi-key updates elegantly, but current fix is sufficient.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for BOM Create + Edit + Add-line flows and regression nav

seed_data_creation: Created one new BOM: Article X, v1, line Rexine Black 0.3m (via UI). Also edited seed BOM 04 to add Buckle line 1.5pcs and version=2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BOM Editor is fully functional. Confirmed both POST /api/boms and PUT /api/boms/{id} fire correctly with all line data including newly-selected material_id. No further BOM retesting needed unless code changes. Backend suite from iteration_2 remains valid.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the previous stale-closure bug was chained non-functional setState calls (updLine called twice in a row for material_id and uom, second call overwriting the first because it captured pre-update `form`). Fix applied at Masters.jsx line 201: single setForm((prev) => {...}) functional updater that mutates both material_id and uom in one atomic state transition. Verified via network capture: POST payload now contains a non-empty material_id.
